# Anycode v0.3.2

Anycode v0.3.2 is a patch release fixing agent auto-scroll layout thrashing on Windows, terminal stdout/stderr drain synchronization, supporting insecure HTTP contexts without HTTPS restrictions, theme-adaptive tab header overlays, and adding per-commit binary installation support.

## Agent Chat & Auto-Scroll

- **Windows Auto-Scroll Loop Fix**: Resolved layout thrashing and infinite scroll loops during agent stream processing on Windows. Eliminated dynamic scrollbar-toggling CSS classes that repeatedly triggered resize observers, replacing them with stable thin scrollbar styling.

## Backend & Terminal

- **Terminal Output Drain Synchronization**: Ensured background stdout and stderr reading tasks are fully drained and joined before signaling terminal exit status, preventing truncated command output in agent terminal runs.

## HTTP Context Compatibility & Polyfills

- **Insecure Context Support (LAN / HTTP)**: In non-HTTPS environments (e.g. accessing Anycode over a local network IP without TLS), `crypto.randomUUID` is restricted by browser security policies. Added a robust UUID polyfill fallback and protocol/host detection for seamless operation over standard HTTP and WebSockets.
- **Polyfill Recursion Safety**: Prevented potential recursive self-calls in the `crypto.randomUUID` fallback implementation.

## Layout & Themes

- **Theme-Adaptive Tab Header Actions Overlay**: Tab header action overlays now dynamically inherit the active editor theme background (`var(--theme-background)`) instead of using hardcoded colors. In dynamic/transparent background modes, overlays feature smooth 12px backdrop blur and semi-transparent tinting.

## CI & Installer Improvements

- **Commit Builds in Installers**: `install.sh` and `install.ps1` now support `--commit <SHA>` (or passing a 7-40 character commit hash) to directly download and install binaries built by CI for any specific commit.
- **Fast CI Artifact Publishing**: Optimized `test-build.yml` to upload Linux and Windows CLI artifacts immediately upon job completion without waiting on macOS runners.

**Full comparison:** `v0.3.1...v0.3.2`
